defaults.t2: Ask us anything else at the first meeting, or call
Can we switch accountants halfway through the year?
defaults.t3: Yes, and it's common. We ask your current accountant for your files, pick up from the last lodged BAS and make sure nothing is missed in the handover. Most switches take two to three weeks.

defaults.t2: Why fixed monthly fees instead of hourly billing?
defaults.t3: Because you should be able to call us without watching the clock. Your fee covers the work in your plan and the questions that come with it. If you need something outside it, we quote first.

defaults.t2: Do we need to change accounting software?
defaults.t3: No. We work in Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks. If your setup is costing you time we'll say so, but the choice is yours.

defaults.t2: Do meetings happen in person?
defaults.t3: Whichever you prefer. Our office is in the city, but most monthly reviews happen on a 30 to 45 minute video call.

defaults.t2: Are you registered tax agents?
defaults.t3: Yes. Our registration number is at the bottom of this page, and our partners are members of a professional accounting body.
